BiblicalUsage: The word names strength or resources, and Elihu uses it once, asking Job whether God will esteem his riches, or gold, or all the forces of strength. No amount of wealth or power can buy a man out of the distress God has appointed.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that riches and strength are no ransom before God, and the man who trusts in them will find them empty when he needs them most.
